initialIssue.body:
## Configuration boundary

The held native-host workflow at `2032975cbad924e63ac98bc69e14a56b20288275`
runs ordinary source identity before the canonical `provenance-before` step.
Its build, Clippy and nextest conditions explicitly use
`!cancelled() && steps.identity.outcome == 'success'`.
The smoke condition checks cancellation and build success.
None checks canonical-before success.
No job or step declares `continue-on-error`.

Current GitHub expression documentation states that a status-check function overrides implicit `success()`.
The complete configuration therefore allows these conditions to remain true after canonical-before fails,
provided their named prerequisites succeed and the workflow is not canceled.
This is a source/documentation inference, not a historical provider observation of rejected-cohort source execution.
No false common-bound execution credit is established.

The affected final routes share this workflow:
`native.hosts` for source `cb95cf6d785c3073c192b95f0632cdae7b910894`,
and `desktop.macos` for source `3434eaa455d569c18b52cf15100f77f9db251d21`.

## Trial repair and controls

Held repair `8c1eac43273b0b0d468a54affd15dc9612d7fe49`
adds `steps.provenance-before.outcome == 'success'` to those four conditions.
Original source commands, independent source-identity recording, canonical helper,
and provisional case bytes are unchanged.

Five local configured-condition fixtures pass:
accepted common-before, failed common-before, skipped common-before, cancellation,
and a failed build that preserves independent Clippy/nextest eligibility while withholding smoke.
Removing the predicates in a disposable in-memory workflow again admits all four consumers after failed common-before.
These controls evaluate the exact restricted configured boolean forms;
they do not emulate the whole GitHub expression language.

Development-only [run39025557306](https://github.com/Aquaticats/Monochromatic/actions/runs/39025557306)
uses a clean pushed pilot ref with the same conditions and commands,
and only a20-minute job bound in place of the held route's90-minute bound.
The actual provisional native case remains `completeGraph: false`.
The canonical guard must reject it before original consumers execute.
Terminal step reconciliation is pending.
No fake common manifest was published and no final coherent dispatch occurred.

## Acceptance

- Accepted common-before preserves original source eligibility and independent failure continuation.
- Failed or skipped common-before withholds build, Clippy, nextest and smoke.
- Actual provider rejection leaves the original consumer steps skipped.
- Independent source identity remains recorded after rejection.
- Common-bound credit still requires successful exact-bound before/after receipts and complete selected coverage.
- Preserve historical source failures and all development provider usage separately.

## Distinct boundary and evidence

All-state searches for `provenance-before`, `common-before` and `cohort guard` were read.
Compared the complete bodies of #1119, #1141, #1144, #1160, #1161, #1157 and #1113.
#1141 repairs a guard accepting a provisional logger case;
this native workflow must respect a guard that rejects the case.
#1119 concerns exact-byte retrieval and #1164 concerns unsupported expression scope.
No GitHub service defect or upstream filing is proposed.

Durable route evidence is maintained in
`doc/audit/depot-common-manifest-route-guards-2026-10-17.evidence.json`.
The final coherent cohort remains held.
